tagline: Protecting families and communities through comprehensive insurance solutions
hero_kpi_rationale: The New Insurance Written KPI is the primary driver of growth in the mortgage insurance sector, reflecting the company's ability to generate new revenue and strengthen its in-force insurance portfolio

kpis.name: New Insurance Written
kpis.explanation: Amount of new mortgage insurance written by Enact during the year
kpis.description: The amount of new insurance written is a key indicator of the company's financial health and competitive position in the private mortgage insurance market

kpis.name: Loss Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio of claims to net earned premiums for mortgage insurance
kpis.description: The loss ratio measures the proportion of premiums used to cover claims. An increase reflects a rise in new defaults, partially offset by favorable reserve releases

kpis.name: Net Earned Premiums
kpis.explanation: Total amount of net earned premiums by Enact after reinsurance cessions
kpis.description: Net earned premiums reflect the company's insurance revenue after deducting premiums ceded to reinsurance. Stability is due to offsetting increases in in-force insurance and declines in average premium rates

kpis.name: Total Revenue

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to interest rate fluctuations that may affect the value of its investments and liabilities. The report mentions significant exposure to interest rate risk, notably through its floating rate debt of $539 million maturing in 2066 and partially hedged by interest rate swaps. A 100 basis point increase in interest rates could potentially generate an estimated loss of $3.1 billion on the investment portfolio

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to financial market fluctuations that may affect the value of its investments. The report mentions significant market risk exposure through its diversified investment portfolio, with an estimated potential loss of approximately $50 million in the event of a 10% decline in equity markets

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risks related to its investments, commercial mortgage loans, and reinsurance counterparties. The report mentions exposure to credit risk but does not provide a specific estimate of maximum potential loss

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations from GSEs (Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac) and the FHFA, including PMIERs requirements that dictate capital standards and eligibility conditions for insuring mortgage loans. The planned adoption of VantageScore 4.0 and revisions to PMIERs requirements phased between March 2025 and September 2026 introduce growing regulatory uncertainty

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company may be exposed to liquidity risks related to its investments and liabilities, including its debt obligations of $783 million for Genworth Holdings and $750 million for Enact Holdings. The report mentions liquidity requirements that must be met and obligations to guarantee certain reinsurance agreements

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies was found in GNW's 10-K filing. The company focuses on traditional mortgage insurance operations without emphasis on AI-driven innovations
